versions.name: Safety
versions.description: Spot hazards at home and in public, draw a fire-escape plan and drill it, assemble an emergency supply kit, and work out how to stay safe from crime, assault and online scams.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
